svg.title: An artery widens as each heartbeat pushes blood through it; below, in time with it, the light the sensor reads falls (drawn flipped, as a peak): the rise of the beat, a small notch, the slow fall to the next
svg.text: the heartbeat the sensor sees (more blood: less light, drawn up)

g.text: the beat arrives: a fast rise
a notch: the heart's valve closes
a slow fall to the next beat

svg.text: time: three beats, about a second each
